result.Method of Attack: Encrypts files on compromised machine and demands ransom for decryption; uses DLL sideloading via malicious oci.dll loaded by MSDTC service; dropper packed with UPX executed via rundll32.exe; anti-VM and sandbox evasion checks (multi-core CPU, RAM >= 2GB, physical disk geometry check); ransom note prepended to encrypted files instead of separate file
result.Attack Vector: Unknown, likely similar to other ransomware groups (e.g., phishing, exploit)
Indicators of Compromise: Bitcoin ransom address (no funds at time of writing)
Use of Proton Mail email address for contact
